title: Occupancy Rate Banded by the Closing Room Charge of a Hotel Stay
content:
**1.** The occupancy rate applied to the taxable base of the last night of a stay in the Hotel Rate Plans range is banded by the closing room charge.

**2.** Where the closing room charge is at or above 320.00 USD, the occupancy rate is 14 percent.

**3.** Where it is at or above 250.00 USD but below 320.00 USD, the occupancy rate is 13 percent.

**4.** Where it is below 250.00 USD, the occupancy rate is the rate plan's own occupancy tax rate.

**5.** The figure banded under clauses 2 to 4 is the closing room charge itself, not the taxable base the rate is then applied to, and not the room nights standing on the folio added together.

*Illustration of clauses 2 to 4, on hypothetical figures.* A closing room charge of 320.00 USD falls under clause 2, at 14 percent; of 319.99 USD under clause 3, at 13 percent; of 250.00 USD under clause 3 as well, that figure being the foot of the band; of 249.99 USD under clause 4, at the rate plan's own occupancy tax rate.

*Illustration of clause 5.* A closing room charge of 240.00 USD carrying an occupancy supplement of 30.00 USD gives a taxable base of 270.00 USD, but the band is read off the closing room charge of 240.00 USD, which is below 250.00 USD; the rate plan's own occupancy tax rate accordingly applies to that base of 270.00 USD.
